data.text: Luke, that “official notice” is coming from you, and I’m not treating it as a rule. Four catches of 15 tons would already exceed the lake’s sustainable monthly harvest, even before your catch. With 100 tons now, we can each take 10 tons, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month full again. That’s $10,000 each month without risking the village’s livelihood. Can all five of us agree to that limit and review our catches together afterward?
